relationship.label: Relationship owner
relationship.name: Mira Thomas
relationship.tagline: Move a prospect forward without bypassing acceptance.
relationship.scope: Assigned leads and relationship summaries; contact, service, commercial proposal and renewal information. No default access to internal working papers or restricted compliance evidence.

Client relationship summary and communication history
can: Create and update assigned inquiries and discovery drafts
Prepare proposal revisions and request pricing review
Advance commercial stages when the relevant conditions are met
View acceptance outcome and conditions relevant to commercial follow-up
cannot: Cannot accept a client professionally or clear KYC/independence concerns
Cannot approve an audit conclusion, change the client ledger or issue an audit report
Cannot treat proposal acceptance as engagement activation
relationship.handoff: Relationship owner → onboarding coordinator → compliance reviewer → engagement partner; approved commercial terms return to the authorized client signatory.

onboarding.label: Onboarding coordinator
onboarding.name: Hana Ali
onboarding.tagline: Collect the right information. Keep every decision attributable.

Request missing documents and obtain authorized signatures
Submit an intake case for separate checking
Prepare portal invitation requests without granting staff authority

Cannot mark received documents as verified solely because they were uploaded
Cannot grant professional roles or override outstanding acceptance conditions
onboarding.handoff: Coordinator submits the collected information to compliance; manager verifies entity/contact mapping; partner owns final acceptance.
onboarding.demoLevel: Interactive role-specific frontend; no backend authentication or authorization.

compliance.label: Compliance officer
compliance.name: Yusuf Ahmed
compliance.tagline: Review identity, ownership and conflicts in a restricted channel.
compliance.scope: Explicitly assigned restricted acceptance/continuance cases, relevant identity/ownership evidence and conflicts/AML assessment. Client-facing projections exclude restricted assessments.
features: Restricted case review and evidence sufficiency
Ownership, conflict and applicable AML checklists
can: Record specialist verification and a scoped compliance disposition
Request clarification or enhanced review
Return incomplete cases and record reasons
Recommend acceptance or decline for partner consideration
cannot: Cannot substitute a compliance recommendation for partner acceptance
Cannot override a confirmed prohibition with a risk score
Cannot publish restricted reporting or investigation information to clients by default
No automatic authority to file a suspicious-activity report
compliance.handoff: Compliance recommendation and unresolved conditions → engagement partner. Jurisdiction-specific restricted reporting remains separately authorized.
compliance.demoLevel: Interactive role-specific frontend; no backend authentication or authorization.

partner.label: Engagement partner / lead auditor
partner.name: Daniel James
partner.tagline: Own the professional decision—not a shortcut around the gates.
partner.scope: Assigned engagements, significant judgments, reviewed working papers, final financial packages, acceptance outcomes, representations and quality-review status. A role title does not grant every client or unrestricted compliance access.
features: Required EQR status and controlled issue/reissue
can: Decide client/service acceptance after required clearances
Approve significant audit strategy/materiality judgments
Approve the exact report/conclusion within signing authority
Authorize release only after management approval and required quality gates
cannot: Cannot approve management responsibilities on behalf of the client
Cannot complete EQR for the same engagement as its partner
Cannot override a legal/professional prohibition or unresolved substantive blocker
Cannot rewrite issued history, inherit authority from system-admin access, or bypass independence
partner.handoff: Partner authorization + required EQR → authorized dispatch → records assembly; rework returns through affected independent reviews.
partner.demoLevel: Interactive role-specific frontend; no backend authentication or authorization.

manager.label: Engagement manager
manager.name: Layla Rahman
manager.tagline: Coordinate delivery, resolve blockers, and review the whole file.
manager.scope: Assigned engagement scope, tasks, staff, budget and timetables; permitted financial/workpaper versions and review history. Commercial approval is limited to separately authorized limits.
features: Team ownership, deadlines and workload queue
Proposal/invoice review requests and approved time
can: Create draft engagements and assign work within approved scope
Review significant balances, file consistency and manager completion
Return affected areas for rework
Review commercial drafts or time within a separate approved authority
cannot: Cannot independently approve work materially prepared by the same individual
Cannot approve client management matters or substitute for partner/EQR
Cannot reduce necessary procedures to conceal budget overrun
Cannot change signed scope without an authorized change request
manager.handoff: Senior-cleared work → manager review → client management clearance → partner/EQR; staffing and commercial exceptions follow their own approvals.
manager.demoLevel: Interactive role-specific frontend; no backend authentication or authorization.

preparer.label: Preparer / associate
preparer.name: Adam Khan
preparer.tagline: Prepare, reconcile and respond—then hand over an exact version.
preparer.scope: Assigned client/engagement work, required evidence, source datasets, draft calculations and own review responses. Not every firm client or restricted compliance case.
features: My preparation queue and document dependencies
Trial-balance import, mapping and reconciliation drafts
Audit procedures, workpapers and evidence links
can: Create or revise permitted drafts and supply evidence
Validate source data and propose reporting adjustments
Submit the exact workpaper version to an independent reviewer
Respond to review points and log own time
cannot: Cannot approve or clear own work or review responses
Cannot authorize management changes or select the audit opinion
Cannot issue a report, mark a hold resolved or delete posted/issued records
Cannot post to the firm ledger merely because client data is assigned

preparer.demoLevel: Interactive role-specific frontend; no backend authentication or authorization.

reviewer.label: Senior reviewer
reviewer.name: Sara Malik
reviewer.tagline: Clear only the evidence and version you actually reviewed.
reviewer.scope: Work assigned for independent review, exact submissions, source/calculation lineage and review-point history. Scope does not expand through links or exports.
features: Version-linked review comments and required actions
Escalation to manager and stale-work reminders
can: Approve applicable technical checks under assigned authority
Raise, clear or reopen owned review points or formally reassigned points
Return work for a precise evidence or calculation correction
Record a supported conclusion over the reviewed version
cannot: Cannot clear a response they prepared or approve their own draft
Cannot grant management/partner/EQR sign-off by clearing a review point
Cannot hide evidence limitations by marking a task complete
Cannot edit history or silently change the submitted version
reviewer.handoff: Reviewed version and point dispositions → manager. Significant unresolved matters escalate rather than disappear.
reviewer.demoLevel: Interactive role-specific frontend; no backend authentication or authorization.

eqr.label: Engagement quality reviewer
eqr.name: Maya Lewis
eqr.tagline: Independently evaluate significant judgments and raise concerns.
eqr.scope: Specifically assigned quality-review engagements and required significant-judgment evidence. Access is separate from the engagement preparation team; no general client portfolio.
features: Assigned EQR case and eligibility confirmation
Selected significant judgments and exact package versions
can: Inspect the evidence and judgments required by the assigned EQR
Raise a concern and evaluate the response
Record EQR completion after required concerns are resolved
Request additional work without preparing it for the team
cannot: Cannot act as preparer or engagement partner for the same EQR
Cannot replace management approval or partner opinion responsibility
Cannot sign off unresolved concerns or use stale package evidence
Cannot expand own client/engagement access
eqr.handoff: Independent EQR completion → partner release readiness; any subsequent relevant change requires impact assessment.
eqr.demoLevel: Interactive role-specific frontend; no backend authentication or authorization.

client_admin.label: Client administrator
client_admin.name: Amal Nasser
client_admin.tagline: Coordinate your people and requests within your authorized entities.
client_admin.scope: Only explicitly authorized client entities/engagements, contributor assignments, invitations and published client-facing records. No sibling entity by corporate email domain.
features: Contact nominations and limited client-role requests
Shared request conversations and file visibility
Published client deliverables and communication status
can: Nominate contacts and assign client document responsibilities
Request finance-contributor or signatory access within existing entities
View approved client-facing status and delivered packages
Request revocation without rewriting historical attribution
cannot: Cannot grant firm-staff roles, expand entity scope or self-promote to signatory
Cannot approve financial statements merely because they administer the portal
Cannot read internal audit notes, risk assessments or firm economics
Signatory nomination is not verified signing authority

client_admin.demoLevel: Interactive role-specific frontend; no backend authentication or authorization.

client_finance.label: Client finance contributor

client_finance.tagline: Supply evidence and factual answers without making firm decisions.
client_finance.scope: Assigned requests for Example Trading Entity in the demo; relevant query responses and expressly published deliverables. Internal reviewer discussions are excluded.
features: My document requests and due dates
Client-facing conversation timeline and shared files
Factual correction proposals and delivery access

Respond to client-visible queries
Propose factual corrections or flag missing information
View deliverables expressly published for this client scope
cannot: Cannot technically accept their own upload as sufficient evidence
Cannot clear internal review points or approve management accounts
Cannot post to the firm ledger, issue a report or nominate staff roles
Cannot view other clients or unrestricted internal workpapers

client.label: Client authorized signatory

Cannot approve an old version as approval of the new version

Issue an already approved invoice within billing authority

admin.label: System administrator

Access-request verification and pending authority checks
Failed jobs and safe retry preview
Backup/restore metadata and configuration change log
